verdict.rationale: Decagon is an enterprise AI customer-support platform, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting, policy, or contractual control that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The nearby items cover different capabilities: scoped session tokens, SSO, and 'data portability and control' for customer context. None of them address model training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
